descriptions.zh:
我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的间谍首脑叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。

现在我们还不知道这位间谍首脑是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis]外星人身份，或是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe]会继续伪装成一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]。但毫无疑问，这是一个巨大的隐患——我们得不惜一切代价把[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]带回来，并对其进行心理辅导。
descriptions.en:
Our Spymaster on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

We are as yet uncertain whether our Spymaster has revealed [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] true alien nature to [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] love interest or if [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe] [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetIsAre] still posing as a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]. Needless to say this is a tremendous security breach - we should do everything in our power to bring our rogue agent back and give [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] some much-needed psychiatric care.

label.zh: 再这么下去，我们会功亏一篑的。

options.script: name = "observation.3101.a"

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了来自[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]表面传来的加密信号。它使用了我们渗透人员常用的频率，但我们的渗透人员现在都没在传输信息。也许这是我们的反叛特工发来的？
descriptions.en: We are picking up a scrambled transmission coming from the surface of [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. It is using a frequency normally reserved for our infiltration cells, but none of them are currently transmitting. Could this be our rogue agent?

options.script:
name = "ONSCREEN"
country_event = { id = preftl_espionage.1003 }

descriptions.zh:
你们是追踪不到这个发射装置的。你们只需要知道我是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]间谍首脑就行。直到不久之前，我一直都很愿意参加对[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的渗透计划。

但我现在不这么想了。我从未想过自己会如此热爱[rogue_agent_country.GetAdj]的文化，我也不会再参与这次的颠覆行动。

我自愿放弃[Root.GetName]的公民身份，再也不会再把自己当做[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]了。
descriptions.en:
Any attempt to track this transmission is futile. You know me as Spymaster [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]. Until recently, I was a willing participant in the criminal infiltration program taking place as we speak on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

No longer. I have come to appreciate [rogue_agent_country.GetAdj] culture in a way I never imagined possible, and I will not aid in its subversion.

I rescind my citizenship in the [Root.GetName]. I no longer consider myself [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 你的想法很危险……你需要帮助。
label.en: You are not well... you need help.

options.script:
name = "observation.3104.a"
response_text = "observation.3104.a.response"
is_dialog_only = yes

label.en: You would throw everything away for a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]?

options.script:
name = "observation.3104.b"
response_text = "observation.3104.b.response"
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 不管你跑多远，我们都会把你抓到。

descriptions.zh:
我方安插在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的密探正在被逐一清理。正在对[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]的潜在目标进行跟踪的几名特工都已经离奇死亡。虽然不能排除刺客来自于当地特种情报机构这一可能性，但看得出来，杀手曾受过[Root.GetSpeciesName]军方训练。

这些暗杀事件很可能都是我方叛变特工所为。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]知道我方的渗透计划，并且受过专门的训练，可以无声无息地消灭敌人。
descriptions.en:
Someone has been picking off our covert operatives on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. Several agents that were shadowing potential [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] acquisition targets have been found dead. While it's not impossible that the assassin or assassins came from an indigenous special forces outfit, the methods used in these takedowns indicate [Root.GetSpeciesName] military training.

There is a high probability that these killings are the work of our rogue operative. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName] knows how our infiltration cells function, and has the training to kill both efficiently and silently.

descriptions.zh:
[rogue_agent_country.GetName]的几家当地媒体开始报道外星阴谋论。虽然尚未有[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的知名媒体报道这个话题，而且已报道的内容也大多只是主观臆测，但其中的某些细节只有我方内部人员才能知晓。

现在我们只能推测，是我方的叛变特工将机密情报泄露给了媒体。我们得尽力减少此事带来的影响。
descriptions.en:
Reports are beginning to surface from local media outlets on [rogue_agent_country.GetName] that speak of some kind of massive global conspiracy perpetrated by aliens. The respectable [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] media has yet to touch this subject matter and much of what has been reported is pure conjecture, but there are some details that could only be known by someone with intimate knowledge of our covert operations.

We can only assume that our rogue agent has been feeding information about our infiltration program to the media. This will require some damage control.

label.zh: 需要进一步控制媒体报道才行。
label.en: We need a firmer grip on their media.

descriptions.zh:
近日，我方在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的一个渗透人员被连根拔除。他们正在对密探进行逐一搜捕。眼见要被抓获时，我方特工都依据密探法则，用瓦解自身的方式进行了自杀。还有一部分特工仍然在躲避追捕，等待着我方的救援。

对方一定是从某种渠道获得了这个渗透人员的部分名单。只有我方的那位叛变特工才拥有这份情报……
descriptions.en:
One of our infiltration cells on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has been all but eliminated in just the last couple of days. The authorities of the nation state in which they were stationed have been hunting them down one by one. Those of our operatives who were in danger of being arrested committed suicide by disintegration as standing protocol dictates. The cell's remaining members are in hiding now, and we are currently working on getting them offworld.

Someone must have tipped the local authorities off and supplied them with a list of all the operatives that were part of this particular cell. Only our rogue agent could have had this information...

descriptions.zh:
我们的情报部门已经确定了位于[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的反叛特工位置！特工们迫切想要解决这位前间谍首脑[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]，但考虑到[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]先前所表现出来的能力，我们无法确保行动成功。我们也可以使用可控的轨道轰炸摧毁[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]所在的整个城市街区，这也是一条极其有效的解决方法。

我们得赶快行动……这样的机会转瞬即逝！
descriptions.en:
Military Intelligence has managed to pinpoint what they believe to be the location of our rogue operative on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]! Our agents are eager to dispatch our former Spymaster [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], but considering the skills [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] largely demonstrated, the success of the operation is not ensured. Destroying the entire city block through limited orbital bombardment has been also been proposed as an extreme, yet extremely effective solution to terminate [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer].

We should strike quickly... we may never get another opportunity like this!

tooltips.zh: 虽然无法保证成功，但好在失败是微不足道的。
tooltips.en: Success is not ensured, but at least failure will be inconspicuous.

tooltips.zh: 效果拔群的解决方案，但是可能引发怀疑。
tooltips.en: Overtly effective solution, might raise suspicion.

label.zh: 不行……这太胡闹了、风险太大。随[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]去吧。
label.en: No... too messy and too risky. Leave [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] be.

tooltips.en: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.

descriptions.zh: 我们没能成功除掉[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的那位反叛特工。情报显示，[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe]和[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis][rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]甜心已经转移到了另一个安全之处，具体地点不明。
descriptions.en: Our plan to eliminate our rogue agent on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has failed - our intelligence sources indicate that [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe] has relocated together with [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] sweetheart to another safe house at an unknown location.

tooltips.en: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.

descriptions.zh: 我们没能成功除掉[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的那位反叛特工。情报显示，[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe]和[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis][rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]甜心已经转移到了另一个安全之处，具体地点不明。
descriptions.en: Our plan to eliminate our rogue agent on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has failed - our intelligence sources indicate that [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe] has relocated together with [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] sweetheart to another safe house at an unknown location.

tooltips.en: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的舰长汇报，火力任务获得成功，有数次攻击直击首要目标。尽管没有回收任何尸首，但我们相信，在这种程度的火力打击下，在我们瞄准的这个街区当中绝对不可能有任何活物幸存。

媒体似乎已经采信了我们的渗透单位编造给他们的故事：一场突发的陨石雨袭击了一处人口密集的城市区域。真是悲剧。
descriptions.en:
The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.

The media appears to be picking up on the story our infiltration cells have been feeding them: a sudden meteor shower that struck a densely populated urban zone. Very tragic.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的舰长汇报，火力任务获得成功，有数次攻击直击首要目标。尽管没有回收任何尸首，但我们相信，在这种程度的火力打击下，在我们瞄准的这个街区当中绝对不可能有任何活物幸存。

我们的特工编造了类似突发陨石袭击这样的故事来掩盖真相，但是当地人完全不吃这一套。尽管媒体在反复地播送陨石袭击的说法，但更多官方报告指出该事件是源于一种“无法解释的外太空现象”。
descriptions.en:
The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.

The cover story elaborated by our agents about a sudden meteor strike, however, has failed to convince the locals. While the media has been repeating the story, more official reports suggest the matter is being blamed on 'unexplained extraterrestrial phenomena.'

descriptions.zh: 我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的特工汇报关于我们反叛的间谍首脑已经被特殊照顾了。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap]的死亡被认为是出于自然原因，刻意播撒的信息让[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim]爱人相信这位特工的生物学终究还是无法适应[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的大气。
descriptions.en: Our agents on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] report the matter of our rogue Spymaster has been dealt with - discretely. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap] death has been blamed on natural causes, and planted information led [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim] lover to believe the agent's body was ultimately incompatible with [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]'s atmosphere.

label.zh: 这将引以为鉴：绝对不要背叛我们。
label.en: This will set an example: never betray us.

descriptions.zh:
在我方试图用替身替换[From.GetName]的某个关键人物时，任务完全败露了。进行任务的特工不是被追杀至死，就是按照规定，为了不被抓获而自杀身亡。

本应被调包的领袖将这一切都归罪到某个敌国身上。因此，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的局势渐渐变得紧张，战争似乎一触即发。我方渗透人员准备进行全球性的舆论造势以缓和局势，但需要我们派遣科研船进入轨道进行协助。
descriptions.en:
Our attempts to replace a key figure on [From.GetName] with a body double from our own ranks has gone terribly wrong. Our agents were discovered, and those who weren't killed in the ensuing firefight committed suicide to avoid capture, as per instructions.

The leader they were sent to replace has blamed this incident on a rivaling nation. International tensions on the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon] are growing and several nations have raised their military readiness levels. Our infiltration cells have prepared a global propaganda campaign to defuse the situation, but they will require a Science Ship in orbit to coordinate their efforts.

label.zh: 再这么下去，我们会功亏一篑的。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们的渗透人员作出了努力，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]的外部关系还是不断恶化，最终演变成了一场全面战争。常规战争只持续了一小段时间，很快各方都开始使用核武。

无数生命从[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表消失，这里已经变成一片放射性废土。就像当地住民一样，我们也损失了数以千计的渗透人员。由于行动失败，我们拆除了轨道观测站，撤离了所有的工作人员。
descriptions.en:
Despite the efforts of our infiltration cells, the deteriorating diplomatic situation between the nation states on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName] has erupted into full-scale war! After a brief period of conventional warfare, all of the combatants made full use of their nuclear arsenals.

The vast majority of life has been cleansed from the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, which has been reduced into a radioactive wasteland. Thousands of our covert infiltrators were lost along with the rest of the population. With the operation having ended in failure, our orbiting Observation Post has been dismantled and the staff evacuated.

descriptions.zh:
得到了轨道上[Root.GetName]的支持，我们的渗透人员成功地在最后关头阻止了[From.from.GetName]即将发生的一场使用核武的战争。一些[From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的领袖——事实上已经被我们的密探给掉包了——呼吁裁减核武，并改善了帝国之间的关系。

随着局势的平息，我们蛰伏特工的影响力提升了。现在整个局势最后对我们非常有利。
descriptions.en:
With the support of the [Root.GetName] in orbit, our infiltration cells managed to avert a global nuclear war on [From.from.GetName] at the last moment. Several [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] world leaders - having been replaced by our own disguised operatives - have called for nuclear disarmament and improved international relations.

With the situation defused, the influence of our covert agents has actually been increased. This entire situation may end up working to our advantage.

descriptions.zh: 某位匿名人士揭露了关于潜伏§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!行动中的某些现象。某些科研团队不仅没有低调行事，反而开始搞起了一些骇人听闻的破坏性项目。
descriptions.en: An anonymous report has emerged which casts a sorry light on our covert infiltration of §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!. Rather than conducting themselves discreetly, some of the science team has instead embarked upon a flagrant and disruptive personal project.

descriptions.zh:
停泊于§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!轨道的科研团队最近没有汇报任何重大发现……应该说，直到有一次显然是喝得酩酊大醉的观测员向总部发送了一条重要更新。

根据这条报告所述：不久之前，一支科研队伍竟然从天而降，并向[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的原住民宣告他们的首席科学官为当地人的神灵。他们不仅成功了，还使得这些原始民为这位首席科学家修筑了一座纪念碑。现在，这座金字塔式的建筑就巍然屹立在这颗星球表面，吸引着四面八方虔诚的朝圣者前来。
descriptions.en:
The science team poised in orbit of §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! had not reported any major findings lately... That is, until a clearly intoxicated observer sent a priority update to headquarters.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.

descriptions.zh:
某位匿名人士表示他对于我们在§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!造成的某些影响十分担忧。我们的观测站人员在进行对[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]原住民的启蒙任务时，擅自“戏弄当地居民”。

根据这条报告所述：不久之前，一支科研队伍竟然从天而降，并向[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的原住民宣告他们的首席科学官为当地人的神灵。他们不仅成功了，还使得这些原始民为这位首席科学家修筑了一座纪念碑。现在，这座金字塔式的建筑就巍然屹立在这颗星球表面，吸引着四面八方虔诚的朝圣者前来。
descriptions.en:
An anonymous whistle-blower is concerned about our influence on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!. It seems the team tasked with enlightening the inhabitants of this [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has taken it upon themselves to 'toy with the locals'.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.

descriptions.zh:
位于§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!轨道观测站的科研人员最近并没有发来什么有用的报告。直到轨道站上一名年轻的科学家向我们指控某些严重的渎职行为。

根据这条报告所述：不久之前，一支科研队伍竟然从天而降，并向[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的原住民宣告他们的首席科学官为当地人的神灵。他们不仅成功了，还使得这些原始民为这位首席科学家修筑了一座纪念碑。现在，这座金字塔式的建筑就巍然屹立在这颗星球表面，吸引着四面八方虔诚的朝圣者前来。
descriptions.en:
The science team observing §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! had not reported anything substantial in a while... That is, until a young scientist stationed on the orbital facility filed a formal allegation of gross misconduct.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.

descriptions.en:
The science team observing §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! had not reported anything substantial in a while... That is, until a young scientist stationed on the orbital facility filed a formal allegation of gross misconduct.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.

label.zh: 这当然是创造历史的一种途径！
label.en: That's certainly one way to make history!

tooltips.en: The civilization on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] is pushed into the next age.

label.zh: 抹去我方行迹，继续工作。
label.en: Erase all our traces and keep working.

label.zh: 希望他们把这些事都忘了吧？
label.en: Let us hope they forget all about it?

descriptions.zh:
§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!上的混乱终于平息了，我们终于得以一览科研团队所引发的灾难性后果了。

短时间内，这颗星球上的大多数人都被卷入了一场全面宗教战争，这是他们称为“天人”的科研团队短暂降临的直接后果。当其中一个交战方为自己的另一位新神修建了另一座金字塔后，争执化为了暴力。在这场宗教冲突中，许多[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都因此而亡。
descriptions.en:
The chaos on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! has at last reached a lull, revealing the full extent of our team's catastrophic intervention.

In a short span of time, large parts of the population broke out into all-out religious war - a direct consequence of the fleeting visitation by a figure they call 'the Skyborn One'. Arguments turned to violence when one of the warring factions constructed another pyramid to their new deity. Many [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] perished in the resulting deadly schism.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们与当地社会发生了意外的接触，但§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!上的事态还是渐渐平息的下来。我们在这的行动并不是灾难性的：反而，当地的人们认为所谓“天人”不过是神话传说，并将大金字塔用作一处特殊的科研基址。

[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName]达到此等文化和历史理解之迅速让我们的科学家们叹为观止。这也支持了[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会即使在不寻常的大事件面前，也能保持强大逻辑思考能力的论断。
descriptions.en:
Things appear to have settled on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!, despite our unscheduled interference with the society dwelling there. Our actions here did not amount to disaster: instead the local population have decided that the "Skyborn One" was simply a myth, and designated the pyramid as a site of special scientific interest.

The sheer speed with which the [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName] arrived at this cultural and historical understanding has fascinated our scientists. It suggests a great capacity for logical thinking among [root.GetPreFTLLower] societies, even when they are faced with extraordinary events.
